 How to watch RB Leipzig vs. Manchester City live on TV and online
 DAZN will broadcast the Champions League match between RB Leipzig and Manchester City live, with a stream available on the platform.
 This week's form: RB Leipzig and Manchester City
 Three wins in their last five competitive matches give RB Leipzig momentum heading into the clash. Leipzig most recently won 2-0 away to Schalke 04 in the Bundesliga, having beaten Elversberg convincingly 4-0 before that. Their two defeats in that period came against Real Madrid (4-1 in the Champions League) and Bayern Munich (6-1 in the Bundesliga). Across those five matches, Leipzig scored twelve goals and conceded twelve.
 Manchester City have won two, lost two and drawn one of their last five competitive matches. They most recently lost 1-0 to Brighton in the Premier League, after beating AEK Athens 5-1 in the Champions League. City scored eleven goals and conceded six across those five matches.
